verdict.rationale: Base44 documents in-app AI agents that update records, trigger workflows and connect to tools, with agent behavior configurable in JSONC files (base44-docs-6, base44-docs-43, base44-docs-51). That covers the agent half of the story. The only documented route for direct LLM calls, though, is connecting to OpenAI, Claude, Groq, Mistral and similar services 'that use an API key' (base44-docs-49), which implies the user manages provider keys. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in, platform-managed LLM calls that need no provider keys; explicit confirmation that app agents run without user-supplied keys; independent or hands-on corroboration.
